prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Noor Halden after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Grocery demand forecasting
client: Marrow & Pine Grocers
client_industry: retail
start: 2021-04
end: 2021-08
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Python
- LightGBM
- Prophet
- Airflow
- BigQuery
implied_skills:
- hierarchical forecasting
built: Weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, scheduled in Airflow
  and written back to BigQuery.
metrics:
- WAPE from 31% to 19%
- spoilage write-offs down 11% in the pilot stores

The review is from: Marrow & Pine Grocers
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on speed and deadlines; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "hierarchical forecasting".
text: Noor got us moving fast on a pretty tight timeline and kept the work on schedule throughout the engagement. We needed weekly store-by-SKU forecasts in place quickly, and they delivered them cleanly through Airflow and BigQuery without a lot of back-and-forth. The forecasting work helped bring WAPE down from 31% to 19%, and we also saw spoilage write-offs drop 11% in the pilot stores. Solid, reliable work from a busy client’s perspective.
